name: denubis-external-agents
description: Dispatch work to a mind that is not this session, as a heterogeneous second voice: external CLI models and other-model advisors alike. Run OpenAI's codex as a critical peer reviewer at whatever model your codex config selects, spawn a different-model advisor in a pane that is structurally unable to implement, or supervise a codex pane through the prompt-file loop and its event monitor. Review paths carry a mandatory provenance check so a confabulated review cannot pass as real. WIP.
